title: Goormaghtigh
statement: For integers x>y>1 and m,n>2, the equation (x^m−1)/(x−1)=(y^n−1)/(y−1) has only the solutions (x,y,m,n)=(5,2,3,5) and (90,2,3,13).

counterexample.description: A new tuple \(x>y>1\), \(m,n>2\), with equal repunits, beyond common values 31 and 8191. Exact big-integer evaluation is a cheap check.
